title: Hash preloading fails with multiple associations in Rails 4.1
body:
Preloading using hash syntax fails with multiple associations in Rails 4.1. git bisect points to [this commit](https://github.com/rails/rails/commit/18dccdccf75e4084718622f578a1ff98f2da6955) specifically removing preloading of more than 1 association. Since this is working in Rails 4.0.x, I'm wondering if this is a breaking change in Rails 4.1 or a bug.

Reproducible test case:

```
# Activate the gem you are reporting the issue against.
require 'active_record'
require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'logger'

# Ensure backward compatibility with Minitest 4
Minitest::Test = MiniTest::Unit::TestCase unless defined?(Minitest::Test)

# This connection will do for database-independent bug reports.
ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: 'sqlite3', database: ':memory:')
ActiveRecord::Base.logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)

ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :posts, force: true do |t|
    t.integer "parent_post_id"
    t.integer "author_id"
  end

  create_table :authors, force: true
end

class Post < ActiveRecord::Base
  belongs_to :parent_post, class_name: 'Post', foreign_key: :parent_post_id, inverse_of: :replies
  has_many :replies, class_name: 'Post', foreign_key: :parent_post_id, inverse_of: :parent_post

  belongs_to :author

  scope :with_includes, -> { preload(:author, replies: :author, parent_post: :author) }
end

class Author < ActiveRecord::Base
  has_many :posts
end

class BugTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_association_stuff
    author1 = Author.create
    author2 = Author.create
    author3 = Author.create
    post1 = Post.create(author: author1)
    post2 = Post.create(author: author2, parent_post: post1)
    Post.create(author: author3, parent_post: post2)

    post = Post.with_includes.find(2)

    assert_equal true, post.parent_post.association(:author).loaded?
    assert_equal true, post.replies.first.association(:author).loaded?
  end
end
```

`active_record` 4.0.x results:

```
...
.
1 runs, 2 assertions, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips
```

`active_record` 4.1.0 results:

```
...
F
  1) Failure:
BugTest#test_association_stuff [preload_relationships_of_same_class_test.rb:47]:
Expected: true
  Actual: false

1 runs, 1 assertions, 1 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips
```
